description: Rutschungsflächen Steiermark is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by service.stmk.gv.at. Sliding surfaces, digitized from plans after fitting into digital catastral folder. (INSPIRE Annex III - this record is no longer maintained). Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Sliding areas Styria" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Hangrutschung, Steiermark, HighValueDataset. The listing shows 2 download or service links in KML, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
